title: What a client may ask hpcworker
description: The command lines another program types to the lab's shared copy (docs/V11_CONTRACT.md section 4) and the lines the gate accepts as its forced command (docs/V12_CONTRACT.md 'The gate'). Everything else hpcworker takes is for people at a terminal and may change in any release. <tool> is <shared_install>/bin/hpcworker, <shared_install> the site profile's value. A value is checked against its pattern before it is placed; a client never quotes around a bad value. Outputs are read through lines.json and the schemas.

login.note: fresh is refused: HPCW-STEP failed usage, exit 2

commands.stdin: the pasted code, once, after the code-prompt line

commands.note: typed by the student in their own terminal, never by a client's own shell

gate.description: SSH_ORIGINAL_COMMAND, exactly one of these lines; anything else: HPCW-GATE refused, exit 126

verbs.reads: lines.json step family; never signin (the gate runs --login never)
the file's bytes; progress.log's last 256 KB
lines.json key family: forgotten, none or stuck
